tools.name: read_page
tools.description:
Open the public web page for a library location.
    Grisez sections include a link and an iframe of twotlj.org.
    Finnis locations include the public record of the book.

    Args:
        doc_id: The document ID (e.g., "twotlj_v2")
        page_num: The location number returned by search

tools.name: search_library
tools.description:
Find the public page for a topic.
    Each Grisez hit is a link and an iframe of the author's site.
    A Finnis hit is the public record of the book.

    Args:
        query: The topic to find (e.g., "virtue in marriage", "hope")
        limit: Number of public pages to return (default: 5)

tools.name: get_table_of_contents
tools.description:
List the public sections of a Grisez volume, or the public record for Finnis.

    Args:
        doc_id: A document ID such as twotlj_v1, twotlj_v2, or twotlj_v3

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description:
Cite a location and link to its public page.

    Args:
        doc_id: The document ID
        page_num: The location number
        style: 'chicago' or 'mla'

tools.name: find_page_by_chapter
tools.description:
Find a public section by its heading.

    Args:
        doc_id: The document ID (e.g., 'twotlj_v2')
        chapter_query: Words from the section heading

tools.name: find_question
tools.description:
Find a public Grisez section whose heading matches a topic.

    Args:
        topic: Words from the section heading (e.g., "faith", "hope")
